scope: Static review of notifications and proposed private push matches only; no tests or production writes

currentProductionNotificationRules.summary: Existing production create accepts any signed-in writer; owner update can change recipient/content. These are baseline findings, not introduced by paused deployment.

findings.issue: Authenticated users can create inbox entries for arbitrary recipients without verified source IDs.
findings.recommendation: Use the prepared source-authorized notification patch before opening production delivery; reconcile old writer contracts separately.

findings.issue: Owner update has no immutable recipient or field allowlist in current production rules.
findings.recommendation: Use immutable userId and restricted read-state updates in deferred notification patch.

findings.issue: Notification fields/read arrays lack comprehensive type/size bounds; not a new paused-only change.
findings.recommendation: Do not broaden authorization or trust HTTP content; bound server-generated content and account for remaining client-write limits before broad activation.

pausedOnlyProposal.summary: Adds ten private push matches denying all client reads/writes; preserves existing production rules byte-for-byte outside the insertion. Existing isAdmin/activeUser helpers remain unchanged and isAdmin is not client-creatable/updatable through self profile edits.
